gabaldon.dialogue.body-language-counterp: Use contemporary American speech particular to Mara, Livia, Miriam, and Jonah; pair it with body language that changes the exchange.
gabaldon.imagery.selective-sensory-logis: Use present-day compound objects and bodily cues through two or three precise senses; each detail establishes position, pressure, or desire.
gabaldon.discourse.embodied-close-viewpo: Stay in Mara's close third-person experience and infer every other mind from action, timing, voice, and posture.
gabaldon.prose.plain-detail-lyric-releas: Write contemporary idiomatic prose, mostly plain and concrete; reserve lyrical expansion for a real turn in pressure or intimacy.
